Product Description

These skate-inspired sneakers from adidas are a pair you'll keep coming back to. Made with classic clean lines, they compliment everything from your casual joggers to tailored pants. A soft inner lining keeps the foot wrapped in lightweight comfort, while the reinforced toe holds up to wear. It all rides on a rubber outsole for excellent traction no matter what the day brings.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these shoes to be of good quality, comfortable, and trendy, with one customer noting they don't rub on the heel. The shoes fit well, particularly for wide feet, and come in various colors, with one customer mentioning the color helps hide dirt. Customers appreciate their versatility for casual wear and lightweight design. Regarding size, while some find them true to size, others report they run small.

    These Adidas Men's Daily 4.0 shoes are amazing. I took them out of the box, cut off the tag, tightened the laces a bit, and wore them out that same night. They were comfortable from the start and they also look incredible. The first place we went someone complimented them and asked where I got them. The Wonder Beige color is very neutral and goes well with shorts, jeans, and casual pants. The Adidas 3-Stripes is classic and the quality is excellent. They feel very well made, with no loose stitching or blemishes anywhere. The size is true, the inside is very comfortable, and the flat sole reminds me of my old Converse All Stars. I think these are best for casual walking around. I don’t think I would wear them all day long. Overall, I'm more than satisfied with these stylish, well-made shoes, and I highly recommend them.

    Reviewed in the United States on July 12, 2026

    These shoes are dope! They fluctuate in price, so keep an eye on them and you can get them for pretty cheap. I am a 12, and buy wide when a available; these fit fine. I have several pair, and prefer the canvas-like material better than the suede-like. I feel like they hold up better, and don't show wrinkles in the toe. So, just be aware of the material when you choose a color. I also have the green/ gum and the charcoal/ gum.

    I wouldn't say these are super comfy. They are more for fashion. So, I wouldn't suggest wearing these if you're going to be on your feet all day at a theme park, or zoo, or festival, or whatever. Dinner and a movie? These are perfect.

    As a 50+ guy, I grew up in Nike Air Max and AF1s. As I've aged, I've become more of a Vans kinda guy. Spending more than 50 or 60 on shoes just doesn't make sense for me any more. These check all my boxes.

    These are a high quality factory made shoe. They are not wide and seem almost narrow. When I measured them they run true to the manufacturer size chart.

    They are in my opinion very similar comfort, and thickness wise to what I remember a Chuck Taylor Converse All Star was.

    Material and breathability they are what I expected. I use these shoes for dirty activities because I can spray them off with the hose and dry them on a Peet boot dryer.

    I should have ignored the reviews and measured my feet first before ordering. They fit very tight and that was my fault. So highly suggest to measure your feet with a metric ruler, write your measurements down, and go to the Adidas website. Refer to their their size chart.

About this Item

  • Classic skate-inspired sneakers for stylish everyday wear
  • FLEXIBLE UPPER: Soft textile upper is stretchy and comfortable
  • REINFORCED TOE: Added protection in the toe area offers extra durability
  • TEXTILE LINING: Textile lining provides a soft, comfortable feel
  • RUBBER OUTSOLE: The rubber outsole provides outstanding grip and a sleek, low-profile look

Product Description

These skate-inspired sneakers from adidas are a pair you'll keep coming back to. Made with classic clean lines, they compliment everything from your casual joggers to tailored pants. A soft inner lining keeps the foot wrapped in lightweight comfort, while the reinforced toe holds up to wear. It all rides on a rubber outsole for excellent traction no matter what the day brings.
